verdict.rationale: Langfuse's own API & data platform overview lists an official CLI for working with Langfuse "from a terminal or coding agent". It positions this CLI against its MCP server, which is meant for AI tools that cannot run shell commands, so the CLI is clearly aimed at AI-native, agent-driven workflows. missing for 10: details of CLI commands, scope and installation, and independent or hands-on corroboration of CLI usage.
